works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 深色高端咖啡电商 App：商品页用"Roasted the day you order"讲烘焙故事、购物车里内嵌优惠码行、结账按钮常驻不消失；内容型电商可以借鉴这种把编辑感商品 Hero 嵌进购买流的做法。
works.comment_en: Dark, premium coffee-commerce app: "Roasted the day you order" product storytelling, a promo-code row inside the cart, and a persistent checkout CTA — a case for embedding editorial product heroes into the purchase flow.
works.title: Coffee Shop eCommerce Mobile App UI Design

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: 医疗预约 App：开屏"Better care. Less waiting."配日历式预约流程，时段选择与单次价格明示，健康总览还带了微型趋势图；预约类 App 的日期/时段选择器模式值得抄。
works.comment_en: Health booking app: "Better care. Less waiting." onboarding plus a calendar booking flow with time slots and per-visit pricing, health-overview sparklines on top — the date/time-slot picker is a pattern worth stealing for booking apps.
works.title: Health App - Doctor Appointment Booking

works.author: Mako Tsereteli
works.comment: 记账预算 App 的 3D 拆解展示：玻璃拟态界面以爆炸视角呈现手机内部层级，用景深讲 App 的信息架构；把复杂金融流程做得可触摸，作品集或产品展示页可借鉴。
works.comment_en: A budget app rendered in exploded 3D: glassmorphism UI with phone layers pulled apart to visualize information architecture — depth and layering make complex fintech flows feel tangible; worth borrowing for portfolio showcases.
works.title: 3D App Design

works.author: Xopher Molitor for Heyo
works.comment: Govee 智能家居 App 重设计概念：深色设备网格，每个灯具都是一块发光的方块，用明暗与色彩而非文字表达开/关与亮度状态；IoT 产品表达设备状态的强模式。
works.comment_en: A Govee smart-home app redesign concept: a dark device grid where each lamp is a glowing tile — on/off and brightness communicated through luminosity and color rather than text; a strong IoT pattern for expressing device state.
works.title: Govee App Redesign Concept

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa for Korsa
works.comment: 康养品牌 Velora 落地页：满屏自然意象、超大衬线标题配悬浮玻璃拟态卡片；编辑感排版加悬浮 UI 卡的 Hero 组合，把产品深度传达出来了，落地页设计可参考。
works.comment_en: Wellness landing page for Velora: full-bleed nature imagery, an oversized serif headline, and floating glassmorphic cards — the editorial-typography-plus-floating-UI hero composition conveys product depth; worth studying for landing pages.
works.title: Velora - Wellness Landing Page

works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto for Plainthing Studio
works.comment: AI 心理健康平台 Solma（动效展示）：柔和的天空蓝配色、"Completely anonymous"的信任优先文案、Hero 里悬浮的对话卡片；敏感型 AI 产品的配色系统与文案调性可参考。
works.comment_en: AI mental-health platform Solma (animated showcase): a soft sky-blue palette, trust-first "Completely anonymous" positioning, and floating conversational cards in the hero — a color system and copy tone worth borrowing for sensitive AI products.
works.title: Solma Web Animation - Your mental-health friend
